wholesale.title: One commercial order policy
wholesale.subtitle: One global commercial order policy
wholesale.body: Minimum order quantity (MOQ): 7,500 litres of olive oil per order. Mixed 250 ml, 500 ml and 750 ml bottle sizes available. Loading plan subject to confirmation.
wholesale.note: The minimum applies to the total olive-oil volume per order and is not a guarantee of container capacity.

origin.title: From olive groves to traceable lots
origin.subtitle: From Moroccan groves to traceable lots
origin.body: GANLAN GOLD coordinates Fouad’s agricultural operation with selected neighboring olive growers through defined sourcing, lot traceability and quality-control preparation, grounded in Morocco’s olive-growing heritage.
origin.note: The origin of each lot remains subject to its commercial documentation and final confirmation.

visit.title: See the Moroccan supply chain firsthand
visit.subtitle: Arrange a professional visit in Morocco
visit.body: International importers and professional buyers may request a visit to the olive groves and production facilities. A request does not confirm a date; our team will contact you to coordinate.
visit.consent: I consent to GANLAN GOLD using this information to handle my visit request.

export.title: Clear coordination for Moroccan export preparation
export.subtitle: Clear coordination to the agreed Moroccan handover point

steps.formalities: Applicable export formalities and documentation preparation
steps.handover: Delivery to the agreed Moroccan handover point

export.incoterm: The applicable Incoterm is confirmed in the quotation. Under FOB, delivery is completed when goods are loaded on board at the named Moroccan port. For container cargo handed to a terminal, FCA should be considered with the freight forwarder.
export.excluded: Indicated export prices exclude international freight, applicable international transport insurance, Chinese customs clearance, duties and import taxes. Delivery to the buyer’s warehouse in China is not included.
export.documents: Where confirmed available and applicable, commercial documentation may include the commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, quality-control documentation and applicable export/customs documents.
